reviews.author: Vinodkumar
reviews.title: Excellent Water Purifier – Native M2 Pro
reviews.body: Very good product with a premium design and excellent build quality. The Native M2 Pro looks stylish and fits well in the kitchen. The purification process is convenient, and the water tastes clean and fresh. The overall user experience is good, and the product feels worth the investment. Hoping for reliable performance and reasonable maintenance costs in the long run. Overall, a good choice for home use. 👍

reviews.title: Absolute game-changer for home water purification!
reviews.body: I recently got the Urban Company Native M2 Pro installed, and I am thoroughly impressed. The build quality feels solid and premium compared to standard plastic purifiers.
